output.summary: Deciduous shrub native from northern Pakistan through northwestern India to China. It is densely branched and very thorny, with white flowers in April and May and orange-red to dark-red berry-like fruits ripening from June to September. Its leaves are used to make herbal tea.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves are made into herbal tea; berries are eaten with yogurt in a Himalayan therapeutic use.
